title: CodedFinding
description: Shared pipeline finding contract. A finding is not approved for publication merely because it exists or has no flags.

sourceRef.description: Reference to the source transcript used for this finding.

speakerCode.description: Pseudonymous speaker code, or null when unavailable. Do not substitute the finding ID for a missing speaker code.

quote.description: Evidence quotation to check against the referenced de-identified transcript.

confidence.description: Confidence score between 0 and 1 inclusive. This is not human approval.

tier.description: Source tier accepted by CodedFinding. Tier 3 is excluded.

flags.description: Recorded check failures. An empty array does not prove that checks ran or that human approval was granted.

nonBlankString.description: Contains at least one character not treated as whitespace by Java 17 String.isBlank().
